messages:
ravi: Heads-up — we just saw a sustained delta between EdgeBurst reported minutes and Redwood's ledger for ACME devices, starting ~2026-01-15 03:00 UTC. ~4% of daily usage missing on our side. Anyone tracking ingestion or partner-side heartbeat changes?

liz: ugh — thanks. Is the delta spread across customers or concentrated to a few SKUs?

ravi: looks skewed to EdgeBurst SKU: EB-XL and mostly devices in APAC. Sample: device_42 shows claim events but no usage rows after our dedupe step.

joanna: can you paste the failing payloads? might be signature/time skew or idempotency key collision. acme changed their edge uploader last week.

ravi: pasted sample payloads below (redacted):
```json
{
  "device_id": "device_42",
  "timestamp": "2026-01-15T03:02:14Z",
  "usage_minutes": 7,
  "report_id": "eb-20260115-abc123",
  "signature": "sig_v2:..."
}
```

sam: quick hypothesis: their uploader now sends report_id without the region prefix, so our dedupe key (report_id + region) doesn't match and the event is routed to DLQ then dropped by the partner reconciler.

maria: confirmed on a call with ACME earlier — they rolled a client change that stripped the region for some batches to save payload size. Their team thought we canonicalize region from device_id.

ravi: ok that explains mismatch in join key. But why the ledger shows fewer rows? our ingest pipeline should accept report_id-only and use device->region mapping. maybe the mapper job fell back because device_42 had no mapping in the recent device-sync run.

ops: looking at recent device-sync logs: device-sync job failed on 2026-01-14 23:55 UTC for ~45 minutes due to rate-limit on the device registry API. many device->region mappings were stale after that window.

liz: putting the pieces together: ACME changed report_id shape + device-sync outage => dedupe keys didn't align => events routed to DLQ or accepted with null region => billing join failed => missing ledger rows.

joanna: proposed mitigation: 1) quickbackfill to re-run DLQ events with region resolution fallback, 2) defensive change (short-term) to accept report_id-only when device mapping missing and attach last-known-region tag, 3) ask ACME to stop shipping report_id-only until we deploy fix.

ravi: agree. For (1) I can run a backfill job that replays DLQ from 2026-01-15 00:00 to 2026-01-16 06:00 with a tolerant join. SQL to find missing usage: 
```sql
SELECT r.report_id, r.device_id, r.timestamp
FROM edge_reports r
LEFT JOIN ledger_usage u ON u.report_id = r.report_id AND u.region = r.region
WHERE r.timestamp between '2026-01-15' AND '2026-01-16' AND u.report_id IS NULL
LIMIT 100;
```

maria: I'll message ACME: temporary mitigation window + can they re-run affected batches? Also need to confirm they still sign payloads with sig_v2 header — that prevents replay.

acme-billing-bot: NOTICE: partner ACME reported a client update on 2026-01-14 22:30 UTC — change log available at https://partners/acme/changes. Signature scheme unchanged.

sam: ops, how long to run device-sync backfill safely? we need region mapping for ~6k devices.

ops: estimate 90m with a low-impact window and throttled calls. can push quicker if we only target devices that appear in DLQ list.

liz: prioritize: 1) backfill DLQ with mapping fallback, 2) device-sync targeted run, 3) hold ACME batches. I'll own coordinated comms.

joanna: can we add an alert that fires when ledger vs partner-reported usage delta > 0.5% for 24h per SKU? would help catch similar regressions earlier.

ravi: yes — Redwood console metrics team can configure. I'll open a quick task.

maria: ACME replies: they can re-send the 2026-01-15 window but only as a one-off. They'll also cut a patch to restore region prefix by EOD.

liz: great. action items: 
- ravi: run DLQ backfill with tolerant join (ETA 2h)
- ops: run targeted device-sync (ETA 90m)
- maria: confirm partner resend schedule and send incident note to partnerships@redwood
- joanna: add ledger-vs-partner delta alert (ETA 1d)

ravi: starting backfill now. will post progress and sample reconciled ledgers.

ops: device-sync started (throttled). will update if we see further rate-limit errors.

ravi: backfill complete. reconciled ~3.9% of that day's usage; uploaded to ledger. sample reconciliation attached in S3: s3://redwood-partners/acme/recon/2026-01-15-summary.csv

liz: awesome, closing the loop with ACME and ops. postmortem note later but immediate fix worked. :white_check_mark:
